items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Great trumpet player, Joe Guy -- I did a lot of dates, single dates with these guys

ctx.x: No, I was just writing at that time. Every now and then, being in New York, you know, a few gigs would come up, and I'd take them, just enough to be able to gather new ideas, you know. I would wanted to be around guys, and like those jam sessions at Minton's, you know. Sometimes they

would need a piano player, you know, one of those things, and I would take the thing, man, just to hear what I'd been missing, you know, from certain guys, and I would hear some great things, you know, and I'd remember those things, and in my next arrangement I used to include some of those things, you know, because I always carried my little notebook with me, you know, and those little riffs that they'd make and some hard things. And some of these guys that did some of these things -- the great Dizzy Gillespie,…
We had that gig book, you know. It was simplified--
